questions.question:
खालील शब्दांचा योग्य इंग्रजी अर्थ निवडा:
१. प्रेक्षणीय
२. प्रिय
३. ऐतिहासिक
योग्य जोड्या ओळखा: 'काका-काकू' आणि 'गच्चीतून'
या शब्दांचे अर्थ सांगा: समुद्र, जन्म, मंदिर, किल्ला
वैशाली तिच्या आजीकडे म्हणजे कोठे गेली होती? (Where had Vaishali gone?)
आजीच्या घराच्या गच्चीतून काय दिसते? (What can be seen from the terrace?)
वैशालीने कोणाचे जन्मघर बघितले? (Whose birthplace did she see?)
रत्नागिरीतील प्रसिद्ध किल्ला कोणता? (Which is the famous fort in Ratnagiri?)
स्वातंत्र्यवीर सावरकरांनी ________ मंदिर बांधले.
भगवती किल्ल्याच्या ________ बाजूंना समुद्र आहे.
गणपतीपुळ्याला ________ देऊळ आहे.
खालीलपैकी कोणते शब्द शुद्ध आहेत?
वैशाली रत्नागिरीला कोणाकडे गेली होती? (Who did Vaishali visit in Ratnagiri?)
questions.explanation: The letter clearly states Vaishali went to her grandmother's place in Ratnagiri where her uncle and aunt also live.

questions.question: वैशाली पुढे कोणत्या ठिकाणी जाणार होती? (Which place was Vaishali going to visit next?)
questions.explanation: In the letter, Vaishali mentions that tomorrow they are all going to Ganpatipule, which has a Ganpati temple on the seashore.

questions.question: वैशालीने रत्नागिरीत कोणती ऐतिहासिक ठिकाणे पाहिली? (Which historical places did Vaishali see in Ratnagiri?)
options: थिबा पॅलेस, लोकमान्य टिळकांचे जन्मघर आणि पतितपावन मंदिर (Thiba Palace, Lokmanya Tilak's birthplace and Patitpavan Temple)
questions.correct_answer: थिबा पॅलेस, लोकमान्य टिळकांचे जन्मघर आणि पतितपावन मंदिर (Thiba Palace, Lokmanya Tilak's birthplace and Patitpavan Temple)
questions.explanation: Vaishali mentions she has seen Thiba Palace, Lokmanya Tilak's birthplace, and the Patitpavan Temple built by Veer Savarkar.

questions.question: खालील शब्दांचे इंग्रजी अर्थ निवडा: देऊळ, किनारा, महत्त्व
questions.explanation: 'देऊळ' means temple, 'किनारा' means shore/coast, and 'महत्त्व' means importance.

questions.question: या कथेचा मुख्य संदेश काय आहे? (What is the main message of this story?)
options: भाऊ-बहिणींनी काळजी व प्रेमाने वागावे (Siblings should care for and love each other)
ताप आल्यावर डॉक्टराकडे जावे (One should go to doctor when having fever)
घरात एकटे राहू नये (One should not stay alone at home)
questions.correct_answer: भाऊ-बहिणींनी काळजी व प्रेमाने वागावे (Siblings should care for and love each other)
questions.explanation: This is the correct answer because the story shows how Trisha, who was usually considered clumsy, took good care of her brother Tejas when he was sick. The main lesson is that siblings should help and care for each other. The other options are wrong because: 1) The story is not about school importance, 2) While medical care is mentioned, it's not the main message, 3) The story doesn't say children should never be alone at home.

questions.question: तेजस शाळेतून आल्यावर बेडवर का कोसळला? (Why did Tejas collapse on the bed after school?)
options: त्याला झोप आली होती. (He was sleepy.)
त्याला खूप ताप होता. (He had a high fever.)
questions.correct_answer: त्याला खूप ताप होता. (He had a high fever.)
questions.explanation: Tejas was very weak due to a high fever and collapsed as soon as he reached home.

questions.question: त्रिशाने तेजसची ताप कमी करण्यासाठी काय केले? (What did Trisha do to reduce Tejas's fever?)
options: त्याला कडू औषध दिले. (Gave him bitter medicine.)
कपाळावर पाण्याच्या पट्ट्या ठेवल्या. (Placed cold water strips on his forehead.)
त्याला बाहेर फिरायला नेले. (Took him out for a walk.)
questions.correct_answer: कपाळावर पाण्याच्या पट्ट्या ठेवल्या. (Placed cold water strips on his forehead.)
questions.explanation: Despite being small, Trisha acted wisely by using cold water strips to help her brother.

questions.question: आई-बाबा घरी नसल्यावर तेजसची काळजी कोणी घेतली? (Who took care of Tejas when parents were not home?)
questions.explanation: Even though Trisha was small, she acted maturely and cared for her brother.

questions.question: तेजसने शाळेतून आल्यावर आपली बॅग कोठे टाकली? (Where did Tejas drop his bag after coming from school?)
questions.explanation: Tejas was so weak from fever that he dropped his bag at the door and collapsed on the bed.

questions.question: तेजस कोणत्या वर्गात होता? (Which grade was Tejas in?)
questions.explanation: The story mentions that Tejas was in 9th grade while Trisha was in 1st grade.

questions.question: त्रिशा कोणत्या वर्गात होती? (Which grade was Trisha in?)
questions.explanation: The story mentions that Trisha was in 1st grade while Tejas was in 9th grade.

questions.question: त्रिशाने दादाचे बूट काढल्यानंतर काय केले? (What did Trisha do after removing her brother's shoes?)
options: त्याला नीट सरळ झोपवले (Made him sleep properly straight)
questions.correct_answer: त्याला नीट सरळ झोपवले (Made him sleep properly straight)
questions.explanation: After removing Tejas's shoes, Trisha made him sleep properly straight before getting water and cold strips.

questions.question: त्रिशाने पाणी कसे आणले? (How did Trisha bring water?)
options: खुर्चीवर चढून (By climbing on a chair)
ओट्याजवळ डबा ठेवून त्यावर चढून (By placing a box near the platform and climbing on it)
आईने ठेवले होते (Mother had kept it)
questions.correct_answer: ओट्याजवळ डबा ठेवून त्यावर चढून (By placing a box near the platform and climbing on it)
questions.explanation: Trisha placed a box near the kitchen platform, climbed on it, and took drinking water in a bowl.

questions.category: धडा १९: चित्र: वाचन आणि लेखन (Picture: Reading and Writing)
questions.question: चित्रात कोणते पालेभाजी लावलेली दिसतात? (Which vegetables are seen planted in the picture?)
options: टोमॅटो, कांदे आणि लसूण (Tomatoes, onions and garlic)
कोबी, गाजर आणि मटार (Cabbage, carrots and peas)
बटाटे, वांगी आणि मिरची (Potatoes, brinjal and chillies)
भेंडी, फुलकोबी आणि ब्रोकली (Okra, cauliflower and broccoli)
questions.correct_answer: कोबी, गाजर आणि मटार (Cabbage, carrots and peas)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the text says 'cabbage, carrots and peas are planted in the garden'. The other options are wrong because: 1) Tomatoes, onions and garlic are not mentioned, 2) Potatoes, brinjal and chillies are not mentioned, 3) Okra, cauliflower and broccoli are not mentioned.

questions.category: धडा १९: चित्र: वाचन आणि लेखन (Picture: Reading and Writing)
questions.question: चित्रात मुलगी काय करत आहे? (What is the girl doing in the picture?)
options: ती झाडे लावत आहे (She is planting trees)
ती बागेत पाणी घालत आहे (She is watering the garden)
ती फुले काढत आहे (She is plucking flowers)
ती भाजी विकत आहे (She is selling vegetables)
questions.correct_answer: ती बागेत पाणी घालत आहे (She is watering the garden)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the text says 'a girl is watering the garden'. The other options are wrong because: 1) She is not planting trees, she's watering, 2) She's not plucking flowers, 3) She's not selling vegetables.

questions.category: धडा १९: चित्र: वाचन आणि लेखन (Picture: Reading and Writing)
questions.question: चित्रात कुंपणावर कोण बसलेले दिसत आहे? (Who is seen sitting on the fence in the picture?)
questions.explanation: The picture shows a bird sitting on the fence while the girl waters the cabbage, carrots, and peas.

questions.category: धडा १९: चित्र: वाचन आणि लेखन (Picture: Reading and Writing)
questions.question: चित्रात मुलगी बागेत पाणी घालण्यासाठी काय वापरत आहे? (What is the girl using to water the garden?)
questions.explanation: The girl is using a specific watering can to take care of her vegetables.

questions.question: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे द्या: १. तुळशीबाई कोठे उभी आहे? २. तिच्या डोक्यावर काय आहे? ३. तुळस कशावर डुलत राहते? (Answer: 1. Where is Tulshibai standing? 2. What is on her head? 3. On what does Tulsi keep swaying?)
options: १. बागेत, २. फुले, ३. पाण्यावर (1. In garden, 2. Flowers, 3. On water)
१. अंगणात, २. मंजिरी, ३. वाऱ्यावर (1. In courtyard, 2. Flower stalks, 3. In wind)
१. घरात, २. पाने, ३. झाडावर (1. In house, 2. Leaves, 3. On tree)
१. मंदिरात, २. फळे, ३. हवेस (1. In temple, 2. Fruits, 3. In air)
questions.correct_answer: १. अंगणात, २. मंजिरी, ३. वाऱ्यावर (1. In courtyard, 2. Flower stalks, 3. In wind)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the poem clearly says 'standing in the courtyard', 'flower stalks on head', and 'swaying in the wind'. The other options are wrong because: 1) Tulsi is in courtyard not garden, 2) Tulsi has flower stalks (manjari) not flowers, 3) Tulsi sways in wind not on water, 4) House and temple are wrong locations, leaves and fruits are wrong parts of the plant.

questions.question: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे द्या: ४. तुळशीला कशात मान मिळतो? ५. तुळस कोणाच्या गळ्यात असते? ६. तुळशीला कोणाच्या चरणी वाहतात? (Answer: 4. In what does Tulsi get respect? 5. In whose neck is Tulsi worn? 6. At whose feet is Tulsi offered?)
options: ४. पूजेत, ५. रामाच्या, ६. शिवाच्या (4. In worship, 5. In Rama's, 6. At Shiva's)
४. औषधात, ५. श्रीकृष्णाच्या, ६. विठ्ठलच्या (4. In medicine, 5. In Lord Krishna's, 6. At Lord Vitthal's)
४. स्वयंपाकात, ५. गणपतीच्या, ६. देवीच्या (4. In cooking, 5. In Ganesha's, 6. At Goddess's)
४. अभ्यासात, ५. हनुमानाच्या, ६. गुरूच्या (4. In studies, 5. In Hanuman's, 6. At Guru's)
questions.correct_answer: ४. औषधात, ५. श्रीकृष्णाच्या, ६. विठ्ठलच्या (4. In medicine, 5. In Lord Krishna's, 6. At Lord Vitthal's)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the poem says 'valued in medicine', 'around Lord Krishna's neck', and 'offered at Lord Vitthal's feet'. The other options are wrong because: 1) While Tulsi is used in worship, it gets respect mainly for its medicinal properties, 2) Tulsi is associated with Krishna not Rama, 3) Tulsi is not mainly used in cooking, 4) Tulsi has no special role in studies.

questions.question: तुळस वाऱ्यावर काय करत राहते? (What does the Tulsi keep doing in the wind?)
questions.explanation: Tulsi is described as swaying gracefully in the courtyard breeze.

questions.question: तुळशीला औषधात काय मिळतो? (What does Tulsi get in medicine?)
questions.explanation: Tulsi is highly valued in medicine for its healing properties.

questions.question: तुळस कोठे मानाने उभी राहते? (Where does the Tulsi stand with pride?)
questions.explanation: The special decorative pot where Tulsi is planted is called Vrindavan, where she stands with pride.

questions.question: तुळशीच्या डोक्यावर काय असते? (What is on Tulsi's head?)
questions.explanation: The delicate seeds/flower stalks on top of a Tulsi plant are called Manjari.

questions.question: 'वृंदावनी' म्हणजे काय? (What does 'Vrindavani' mean?)
options: तुळस लावण्याचे खास भांडे/कुंडी (Special pot for planting Tulsi)
questions.correct_answer: तुळस लावण्याचे खास भांडे/कुंडी (Special pot for planting Tulsi)
questions.explanation: 'वृंदावनी' refers to the special decorative pot or structure where Tulsi is planted in Indian homes.

questions.question: तुळशीला फुले किंवा फळे नसतात, तरीही तिला मान का मिळतो? (Tulsi has no flowers or fruits, yet why is it respected?)
options: सुंदर दिसते म्हणून (Because it looks beautiful)
मोठे झाड आहे म्हणून (Because it's a big plant)
देवाचे प्रतीक आहे म्हणून (Because it's a symbol of God)
questions.explanation: The poem states that although Tulsi has no flowers or fruits, it is highly respected for its medicinal properties.

questions.question: तुळशीचा सुगंध कसा असतो? (How is Tulsi's fragrance?)
questions.explanation: The poem says 'सुगंध तुझा दरवळत राही' meaning your fragrance keeps spreading/pervading.

questions.question: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे द्या: १. मेजवानी कोणाच्या घरी होती? २. कोंबड्याला काय काम होते? ३. कोणाचा उपवास होता? ४. कोंबड्याचा कोणावर विश्वास नव्हता? (Answer: 1. At whose house was the feast? 2. What was the rooster's job? 3. Who was fasting? 4. Whom did the rooster not trust?)
options: १. शिकाऱ्याच्या, २. गाणे गाण्याचे, ३. कोंबड्याचा, ४. शिकाऱ्यावर (1. At hunter's, 2. Singing, 3. Rooster's, 4. On hunter)
१. कोल्ह्याच्या, २. सगळ्यांना उठवण्याचे, ३. कोल्ह्याचा, ४. कोल्ह्यावर (1. At fox's, 2. Waking everyone up, 3. Fox's, 4. On fox)
१. शेजाऱ्याच्या, २. अंडी देण्याचे, ३. वाघाचा, ४. वाघावर (1. At neighbor's, 2. Laying eggs, 3. Tiger's, 4. On tiger)
१. राजाच्या, २. जंगलाचे रक्षण करण्याचे, ३. सिंहाचा, ४. सिंहावर (1. At king's, 2. Protecting forest, 3. Lion's, 4. On lion)
questions.correct_answer: १. कोल्ह्याच्या, २. सगळ्यांना उठवण्याचे, ३. कोल्ह्याचा, ४. कोल्ह्यावर (1. At fox's, 2. Waking everyone up, 3. Fox's, 4. On fox)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the story says 'feast at fox's house', 'rooster's job was to wake everyone up', 'fox was fasting', and 'rooster did not trust the fox'. The other options are wrong because: 1) There's no hunter in the story, 2) Rooster doesn't lay eggs, 3) Tiger and lion are not in the story, 4) The story is specifically about a fox and rooster.

questions.question: कोंबड्याने कोल्ह्यावर विश्वास का ठेवला नाही? (Why did the rooster not trust the fox?)
options: कोल्हा त्याचा मित्र होता. (The fox was his friend.)
कोंबडा बुद्धिमान होता. (The rooster was intelligent.)
कोल्हा आजारी होता. (The fox was sick.)
कोंबड्याला भूक लागली होती. (The rooster was hungry.)
questions.correct_answer: कोंबडा बुद्धिमान होता. (The rooster was intelligent.)
questions.explanation: The rooster was clever enough to know that the fox was lying about his fast to try and eat him.

questions.question: 'मेजवानी' या शब्दाचा अर्थ काय? (What is the meaning of the word 'Mejwani'?)
questions.explanation: The fox invited the rooster to his house for a feast to trick him.

questions.question: कोल्ह्याने कोंबड्याला कोणते निमंत्रण दिले? (What invitation did the fox give to the rooster?)
questions.explanation: The fox tried to lure the rooster down by offering to show him the whole jungle, or inviting him for a feast.

questions.question: कोल्हा स्वतःला काय समजत होता? (What did the fox think of himself?)
questions.explanation: At the end of the story, the fox says 'मी तर स्वतःला खूप हुशार समजत होतो' meaning 'I used to think of myself as very intelligent'.

questions.question: कोल्ह्याला शेवटी काय करावे लागले? (What did the fox have to do at the end?)
options: कोंबड्याची माफी मागावी लागली (Had to apologize to the rooster)
स्वतःची फजिती करून घ्यावी लागली (Had to make a fool of himself)
जेवण बनवावे लागले (Had to cook food)
पळून जावे लागले (Had to run away)
questions.correct_answer: स्वतःची फजिती करून घ्यावी लागली (Had to make a fool of himself)
questions.explanation: The fox says 'आता स्वतःचीच फजिती करून घेतली' meaning 'Now I have made a fool of myself'.

questions.question: मनी मांजराबद्दल खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर नाही? (Which statement is NOT true about Mani the cat?)
options: ती पाण्याच्या भांड्यात उडी मारते (She jumps into water vessels)
ती कोमट सूतीसारखी मऊ आहे (She is soft like cotton)
ती परकीयांपासून लपते (She hides from strangers)
ती धीम्या स्वभावाची आणि शांत आहे (She is gentle and calm by nature)
questions.correct_answer: ती पाण्याच्या भांड्यात उडी मारते (She jumps into water vessels)
questions.explanation: This is the wrong statement because the poem never says Mani jumps into water vessels. The other three statements are correct: 1) The poem says she is 'soft like cotton', 2) It says she runs away from strangers, 3) It describes her as gentle and calm.

questions.question: मनी कोणाला पाहून पळून जाते? (Looking at whom does Mani run away?)
questions.explanation: Mani is shy and runs away if someone she doesn't know tries to catch her.

questions.question: मनी मांजरीची शेपटी कशी आहे? (How is Mani the cat's tail?)
questions.explanation: The poem describes Mani as having a long tail and being as soft as cotton.

questions.question: मनी कोणत्या प्राण्याबरोबर खोडी करते? (With which animal does Mani play mischief?)
questions.explanation: The poem mentions that when Motya (probably another pet) sleeps in the afternoon, Mani plays mischief with him.

questions.question: मनी दुपारी काय करते? (What does Mani do in the afternoon?)
questions.explanation: The poem says 'मोत्या गरीब भारी, जेव्हा निजे दुपारी' meaning when poor Motya sleeps in the afternoon.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे द्या: १. बैलाचे नाव काय आहे? २. बैलाला कामाला कधी सुट्टी असते? ३. बैलाला पोळ्याच्या दिवशी काय खायला मिळते? (Answer: 1. What is the bullock's name? 2. When does the bullock have a holiday from work? 3. What does the bullock get to eat on Pola day?)
options: १. राजा, २. दिवाळीला, ३. वरणभात (1. Raja, 2. During Diwali, 3. Varan-bhat)
१. ढवळ्या, २. बैलपोळ्याच्या दिवशी, ३. पुरणपोळी (1. Dhawalya, 2. On Bail Pola day, 3. Puran-poli)
१. श्याम, २. रविवारी, ३. शिरा (1. Shyam, 2. On Sunday, 3. Sheera)

questions.correct_answer: १. ढवळ्या, २. बैलपोळ्याच्या दिवशी, ३. पुरणपोळी (1. Dhawalya, 2. On Bail Pola day, 3. Puran-poli)

The other options are wrong because: 1) Name is not Raja, 2) Holiday is on Bail Pola not Diwali, 3) Food is Puran-poli not Varan-bhat, 4) Name is not Shyam, 5) Holiday is specific festival day not every Sunday, 6) Name is not Motya, 7) Holiday is not every month.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे द्या: ४. बैलाच्या अंगावर कोणते कापड घालून मिरवणूक काढतात? ५. बैलाचा मालक कोण आहे? ६. शेतकरी बैलाच्या पाठीवर काय देतो? (Answer: 4. What kind of cloth is put on the bullock for the procession? 5. Who is the owner of the bullock? 6. What does the farmer do to the bullock's back?)
options: ४. साधे कापड, ५. व्यापारी, ६. फक्त फटके (4. Simple cloth, 5. Businessman, 6. Only whips)
४. भरजरी कापड (झूल), ५. शेतकरी, ६. कधी फटके तर कधी प्रेमाने हात फिरवतो (4. Embroidered cloth, 5. Farmer, 6. Sometimes whips and sometimes strokes with love)
४. रेशीमी कापड, ५. लोहार, ६. फक्त प्रेमाने हात फिरवतो (4. Silk cloth, 5. Blacksmith, 6. Only strokes with love)
४. लोकरीचे कापड, ५. शिक्षक, ६. काहीही करीत नाही (4. Woolen cloth, 5. Teacher, 6. Does nothing)
questions.correct_answer: ४. भरजरी कापड (झूल), ५. शेतकरी, ६. कधी फटके तर कधी प्रेमाने हात फिरवतो (4. Embroidered cloth, 5. Farmer, 6. Sometimes whips and sometimes strokes with love)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the text says 'embroidered cloth is put on', 'owner is the farmer', and 'sometimes whips and sometimes strokes with love'. The other options are wrong because: 1) Cloth is embroidered not simple, 2) Owner is farmer not businessman, 3) Farmer does both whipping and stroking, not just whipping, 4) Cloth is embroidered not silk, 5) Owner is farmer not blacksmith, 6) Farmer does more than just stroking.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: बैल वर्षभर कोठे कष्ट करतो? (Where does the ox work hard all year round?)
questions.explanation: The ox helps the farmer by working in the heat and rain in the fields.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: बैलपोळ्याच्या दिवशी बैलाला कामातून काय असते? (What does the ox have from work on Pola day?)
questions.explanation: Bail Pola is the festival of bullocks, and they are given a holiday from farm work on this day.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: बैलाच्या अंगावर काय घालून मिरवणूक काढतात? (What is put on the bullock for the procession?)
questions.explanation: On Bail Pola, bullocks are decorated with embroidered cloth called 'Jhool' as a mark of respect.

questions.category: धडा २३: मी बैल बोलतो आहे (I am the Ox Speaking)
questions.question: ढवळ्या बैलाला आता काय करायचे वाटते? (What does Dhawalya the ox feel like doing now?)
options: शेतात काम करायचे (Work in the fields)

questions.correct_answer: झाडाच्या सावलीत विश्रांती घ्यायचे (Take rest in the shade of a tree)
questions.explanation: The ox says he is getting old and now feels like sitting peacefully in the shade of a tree, eating fodder, drinking water, and taking rest.

questions.explanation: Note the correct 'u' sound in Purush and the 'tra' sound in Drushya.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: Choose the correct spelling for 'I', 'Seed', and 'Poet':
questions.explanation: In Marathi, 'I' is always written with a long 'i' (मी). Words like 'Bee' and 'Kavi' also use the long vowel at the end.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: Identify the correct group of spellings for 'Teacher', 'Daughter-in-law', and 'Nagpur':
questions.explanation: Note that 'Guru', 'Soon', and 'Nagpur' all require the long 'u' (Ukar) sound for correct writing.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: Which set shows the correct spelling for 'Lamp', 'School bag', and 'Shop'?
questions.explanation: 'Diva' and 'Dukan' use the short vowel sounds (Ikar/Ukar) at the beginning.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: Choose the correct spelling for 'Exam', 'Guest', and 'Waiting':
questions.explanation: 'Pariksha' and 'Pratiksha' must have a long 'i' in the middle. 'Atithi' uses short 'i' sounds.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: What is the correct way to write 'Blessing', 'Rupee', and 'Request'?
questions.explanation: 'Ashirwad' is often misspelled; the 'r' sound must be on the 'va'. 'Rupaya' uses a short 'u'.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: Select the correct spellings for 'Bright', 'Scene', and 'Durva grass':
questions.explanation: 'Ujjwal' has a double 'j'. 'Drushya' ends with a 'ya' sound but is spelled with 'shya'.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: खालीलपैकी कोणता शब्द शुद्ध आहे? (Which of the following words is correctly spelled?)
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'मंदिर' (temple) with the dot/anuswar on 'म', not 'मंदीर' with a long 'ई'.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: 'भूगोल' या शब्दाचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (What is the correct spelling of 'Geography'?)
questions.explanation: 'भूगोल' (Geography) is correctly spelled with a long 'ऊ' at the beginning.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: 'दप्तर' या शब्दाचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (What is the correct spelling of 'School bag'?)
questions.explanation: 'दप्तर' (school bag) is correctly spelled with the conjunct 'प्त'.

questions.category: धडा २४: लेखनातील सामान्य चुका (Common Mistakes in Writing)
questions.question: 'रुपया' या शब्दाचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (What is the correct spelling of 'Rupee'?)
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'रुपया' with a short 'उ' at the beginning, not 'रूपया' with a long 'ऊ'.

questions.question: अशुद्ध वाक्य 'मुलगी खाणे खातो' चे शुद्ध रूप काय? (Correct 'The girl eats food'.)
questions.explanation: For female subjects (Mulgi), the verb ends in 'e'.

questions.question: शुद्ध वाक्य निवडा: 'तुम्ही कसे ________?'
questions.explanation: When using 'Tumhi' for respect or plurals, the verb ends with 'aahat'.

questions.question: अशुद्ध वाक्य 'मुलगा जाते आहे' चे शुद्ध रूप काय? (Correct 'The boy is going'.)
questions.explanation: In Marathi, the verb must match the male gender of the subject 'Mulga'.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'बालिका शिकतो.'
questions.explanation: 'Balika' is female, so the action ending must be '-te' (ते).

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'मुलगी खाणे खातो.'
questions.explanation: The subject 'मुलगी' (girl) is feminine, so the verb must be feminine 'खाते', not masculine 'खातो'.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'असे तो बोलले.'
questions.explanation: For a singular male subject 'To', the past tense verb is 'Bolla'.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'तुम्ही कसे आहे?'
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'तुम्ही' (you - respectful/plural) requires the verb 'आहात', not the singular 'आहे'.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'मि जाते.' (Assuming a female speaker)
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'I' must be spelled with a long vowel as 'मी', not 'मि'. For a female speaker, the verb 'जाते' is correct.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'तो बोलते आहे.'
questions.explanation: The subject 'तो' (he) is masculine, so the continuous tense verb must be masculine 'बोलतो आहे', not feminine 'बोलते आहे'.

questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'असे ती बोलला.'
questions.explanation: The subject 'ती' (she) is feminine, so the past tense verb must be feminine 'बोलली', not masculine 'बोलला'.

questions.question: 'बालिका शिकतो' या अशुद्ध वाक्याचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (Correct the sentence: 'The girl learns'.)
questions.explanation: 'बालिका' (girl) is feminine, so the verb must be feminine 'शिकते', not masculine 'शिकतो'.

questions.question: 'मुलगा जाते आहे' या अशुद्ध वाक्याचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (Correct the sentence: 'The boy is going'.)
questions.explanation: 'मुलगा' (boy) is masculine, so the verb must be masculine 'जातो आहे', not feminine 'जाते आहे'.

questions.question: 'असे तो बोलले' या अशुद्ध वाक्याचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (Correct the sentence: 'He spoke like that'.)
questions.explanation: 'तो' (he) is masculine singular, so the past tense verb must be masculine singular 'बोलला', not plural 'बोलले'.

questions.question: 'तुम्ही कसे आहे?' या अशुद्ध वाक्याचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (Correct the sentence: 'How are you?' - respectful)
questions.explanation: 'तुम्ही' (you - respectful/plural) requires the respectful verb form 'आहात', not the singular 'आहे'.

questions.question: 'मि जाते' या अशुद्ध वाक्याचे शुद्ध रूप कोणते? (Correct the sentence: 'I go' - female speaker)
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'I' must be written with a long vowel as 'मी', not 'मि'. For a female speaker, the verb 'जाते' is correct.

questions.question: The subject 'बालिका' (girl) is feminine. Which verb form is correct for it?
questions.explanation: 'बालिका' is a feminine noun, so the verb must be feminine 'शिकते'. 'शिकतो' is masculine, and 'शिकतात' is plural.

questions.question: The subject 'मुलगा' (boy) is masculine. Which verb form is correct for it?
questions.explanation: 'मुलगा' is a masculine subject, so the verb must be masculine 'खातो'. 'खाते' is feminine, and 'खातात' is plural.

questions.question: The subject 'मुलगी' (girl) is feminine. Which verb form is correct for it?
questions.explanation: 'मुलगी' is a feminine subject, so the verb must be feminine 'जाते'. 'जातो' is masculine.

questions.question: The subject 'ते' (they - boys/mixed group) is plural. Which verb form is correct for it?
questions.explanation: 'ते' (boys/mixed group) is a plural subject, so the verb must be plural 'आले आहेत'. 'आला आहे' is singular.

questions.question: The subject 'त्या' (they - girls) is plural feminine. Which verb form is correct for it?
questions.explanation: 'त्या' (girls) is a plural feminine subject, so the verb must be plural feminine 'गेल्या आहेत'. 'गेली आहे' is singular.

questions.question: For the subject 'तो' (he - masculine), which past tense verb is correct?
questions.explanation: 'तो' is a masculine singular subject, so in past tense the verb must be 'बोलला'. 'बोलली' is feminine, 'बोलले' is plural.

questions.question: For the pronoun 'तुम्ही' (you - respectful/plural), which verb form is correct?
questions.explanation: 'तुम्ही' is a respectful or plural pronoun. The correct verb form is 'आहात'. 'आहे' is singular and informal.

questions.question: What is the correct spelling of the pronoun 'I' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The pronoun 'I' in Marathi is always written with a long vowel (दीर्घ) as 'मी'. Writing it as 'मि' (short vowel) is incorrect.

questions.question: Which of these spellings is correct for 'poet' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The word for 'poet' (कवी) ends with a long vowel (दीर्घ इ). Writing it as 'कवि' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which of these spellings is correct for 'teacher/guru' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The word for 'teacher/guru' (गुरू) ends with a long vowel (दीर्घ उ). Writing it as 'गुरु' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'daughter-in-law' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The word for 'daughter-in-law' (सून) ends with a long vowel (दीर्घ उ). Writing it as 'सुन' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Identify the correct spelling for 'bag' in Marathi:
questions.explanation: The word for 'bag' (पिशवी) ends with a long vowel (दीर्घ इ). Writing it as 'पिशवि' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'lamp' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The word for 'lamp' (दिवा) begins with a short vowel (ऱ्हस्व इ). Writing it as 'दीवा' with a long vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'shop' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The word for 'shop' (दुकान) begins with a short vowel (ऱ्हस्व उ). Writing it as 'दूकान' with a long vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'blessing' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'आशीर्वाद' where the 'र्' comes after 'शी'. 'आर्शिवाद' is incorrect because the 'र्' is placed before 'शि'.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'bright/radiant' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'उज्ज्वल' with a double 'ज्' (ज्ज). Writing it as 'उज्वल' with a single 'ज्' is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'scene/view' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'दृश्य' with the conjunct 'श्य'. Writing it as 'दृष्य' with 'ष्य' is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'exam' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'परीक्षा' with a long vowel (दीर्घ इ) in the middle. Writing it as 'परिक्षा' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'guest' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'अतिथी' with 'ति' in the middle and a long vowel at the end. 'अथीती' is incorrect because it uses 'थी' instead of 'ति'.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'waiting' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'प्रतीक्षा' with a long vowel (दीर्घ इ) in the middle. Writing it as 'प्रतिक्षा' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'Nagpur' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'नागपूर' with a long vowel (दीर्घ उ) at the end. Writing it as 'नागपुर' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'man/male' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'पुरुष' with short vowels (ऱ्हस्व) at the beginning and in the middle. 'पूरूष' with long vowels is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'Durva grass' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'दूर्वा' with a long vowel (दीर्घ उ) at the beginning. Writing it as 'दुर्वा' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which is the correct spelling for 'request' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'विनंती' with a long vowel (दीर्घ इ) at the end and the nasal (अनुस्वार) correctly placed. Writing it as 'विनंति' with a short vowel is incorrect.

questions.question: Which structure is correct for forming continuous tense (is/am/are doing) in Marathi?
questions.explanation: Continuous tense in Marathi follows the structure: Verb stem + तो (masculine)/ते (feminine)/ती (neuter) + आहे. Example: जातो आहे, जाते आहे.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to say 'The boy is going' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: For a masculine subject 'मुलगा', the continuous tense uses 'जातो आहे'. 'जाते आहे' is feminine, 'गेला आहे' is past tense.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to say 'The girl is going' in Marathi?
questions.explanation: For a feminine subject 'मुलगी', the continuous tense uses 'जाते आहे'. 'जातो आहे' is masculine, 'गेली आहे' is past tense.

questions.question: Which number names have correct vowel lengths?
questions.explanation: All these number names have correct vowel lengths: 'पंधरा' (short 'a' at end), 'पंचवीस' (long 'i' in middle), 'पस्तीस' (long 'i' in middle).

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'मुलगा' (boy)?
questions.explanation: Words ending in 'आ' (ा) like 'मुलगा' change to 'मुलगे' in plural form.

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'मुलगी' (girl)?
questions.explanation: Words ending in 'ई' (ी) like 'मुलगी' change to 'मुली' in plural form by removing the long vowel.

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'फूल' (flower)?
questions.explanation: Words ending in consonants like 'फूल' often add 'े' to form the plural 'फुले' with the vowel shortened.

questions.question: What is the singular form of 'उड्या' (jumps)?
questions.explanation: The plural 'उड्या' changes to singular 'उडी' by removing the '्या' ending.

questions.question: What is the singular form of 'फळे' (fruits)?
questions.explanation: The plural 'फळे' changes to singular 'फळ' by removing the 'े' ending.

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'काका' (uncle)?
questions.explanation: The feminine counterpart of 'काका' (paternal uncle) is 'काकू' (paternal aunt).

questions.question: What is the masculine form of 'आई' (mother)?
questions.explanation: The masculine counterpart of 'आई' (mother) is 'बाबा' or 'वडील' (father).

questions.question: What is the masculine form of 'चिमणी' (sparrow - feminine)?
questions.explanation: The masculine form of 'चिमणी' (female sparrow) is 'चिमणा' (male sparrow).

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'मुलगा' (boy)?
questions.explanation: The feminine counterpart of 'मुलगा' (boy) is 'मुलगी' (girl).

questions.question: What is the feminine form of 'कोल्हा' (fox - masculine)?
questions.explanation: The feminine form of 'कोल्हा' (male fox) is 'कोल्हीण' (female fox/vixen).

questions.question: Which sentence correctly follows subject-verb agreement?
questions.explanation: 'मुले' (children) is plural, so the verb must be plural 'जातात'. The other options have gender or number mismatches.

questions.question: १-२-३-४-५ या क्रमाला अक्षरात काय म्हणतात?
मराठीत '३०' आणि '४०' ला काय म्हणतात?
संख्या १५, २५ आणि ३५ यांना मराठीत काय म्हणतात? (What are numbers 15, 25 and 35 called in Marathi?)
questions.explanation: This is correct because 15 = pandhra, 25 = panchavees, 35 = pastees in Marathi. The other options are wrong because: 1) 20 and 30 are vees and tees, not 25 and 35, 2) 10, 20, 30 are different numbers, 3) 5, 15, 25 are different numbers.

questions.question: 'एकोणतीस', 'एकतीस' आणि 'एकोणचाळीस' हे कोणत्या संख्या दर्शवतात? (Which numbers do 'ekonatis', 'ektis' and 'ekonchalees' represent?)
questions.explanation: This is correct because 'ekonatis' means one less than thirty = 29, 'ektis' means thirty-one = 31, 'ekonchalees' means one less than forty = 39. The other options are wrong because: 1) 19 = ekonees, 21 = ekvees, 29 = ekonatis, 2) 18 = athara, 28 = atthaivees, 38 = adotees, 3) 9 = nau, 19 = ekonees, 29 = ekonatis.

questions.question: मराठीत '२४' आणि '२७' ला काय म्हणतात? (24 and 27)
questions.explanation: 24 is Chovees and 27 is Sattavees.

questions.question: अक्षरी लेखन ओळखा: ३३, ३४, ३७, ३८
questions.explanation: These are the specific names for 33, 34, 37, and 38.

questions.question: मराठीत '१३' आणि '१४' ला काय म्हणतात? (What are 13 and 14 called in Marathi?)
questions.explanation: 13 is 'तेरा' (Tera) and 14 is 'चौदा' (Chouda) in Marathi.

questions.question: मराठीत '३१' आणि '३२' ला काय म्हणतात? (What are 31 and 32 called in Marathi?)
questions.explanation: 31 is 'एकतीस' (Ektees) and 32 is 'बत्तीस' (Batees) in Marathi.

questions.question: मराठीत '१५' आणि '१९' ला काय म्हणतात? (15 and 19)
questions.explanation: 15 is Pandhra and 19 is Ekonees.

questions.question: मराठीत '२९' आणि '३९' ला काय म्हणतात? (29 and 39)
questions.explanation: 29 is Ekontees and 39 is Ekonchalees.

questions.question: मराठीत '३८' आणि '३९' ला काय म्हणतात?
questions.explanation: 38 is Adotees and 39 is Ekonchalees.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ल्याचे मूळ नाव काय आहे आणि तो किती वर्षे अपराजित राहिला? (What is the original name of Janjira Fort and for how many years did it remain undefeated?)
questions.explanation: This is correct because the text says 'original name is Janjire Mehroob' and 'remained undefeated for 330 years'. The other options are wrong because: 1) Murud Janjira is the location name not original name, 2) Abhedya killa is a description not the name, 3) Samudragad is a different fort.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ला किती वर्षे अजेय राहिला? (For how many years did Janjira Fort remain undefeated?)
questions.explanation: The sea-fort remained undefeated for 330 years until Chimaji Appa eventually conquered it.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ला कुठे आहे? (Where is Janjira Fort located?)
options: रायगड जिल्ह्यातील मुरुड-जंजिरा येथे (In Murud-Janjira, Raigad district)
questions.correct_answer: रायगड जिल्ह्यातील मुरुड-जंजिरा येथे (In Murud-Janjira, Raigad district)
questions.explanation: Janjira Fort is located in Murud-Janjira in Raigad district.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ल्याला किती बाजूंनी समुद्र आहे? (On how many sides is Janjira Fort surrounded by sea?)
questions.explanation: Janjira Fort is surrounded by the Arabian Sea on all four sides, making it an invincible fort.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ल्यात किती तोफा होत्या? (How many cannons were there in Janjira Fort?)
questions.explanation: Janjira Fort had 572 cannons, which made it invincible.

questions.category: वाचन आनंद: जंजिरा किल्ला (Reading for Joy: Janjira Fort)
questions.question: जंजिरा किल्ला कोणी जिंकला? (Who conquered Janjira Fort?)
questions.explanation: The fort, which remained undefeated for 330 years, was eventually conquered by Chimaji Appa, the brother of the Peshwas.
